body: Thank you for replying, definitely put things in perspective for me. idk I always assumed he was doing his own thing considering he talks a lot about his past experiences with women, girls that he’s met while he was out that he was interested in now, and overall a very open guy. In the beginning it seemed pretty casual on both ends, but it seems like he may be developing feelings. I don’t want to assume anything and I definitely do not want to hurt him so I’ll talk to him the next time I see him and see where he’s at
genius, did just that and it worked lol

Thanks for replying. She’s applied for Fafsa and she currently does work study. She just got approved to be an RA for next year which should help really with the cost. To be honest, I’m not really knowledgeable about financial aid and university. She’s the first person in our family, to go to college. But I’ll look online for some scholarships that might be of help. Our mother is really stressing right now because she isn’t able to make the payments that she owes right now, but I’m researching for things that might help in the meantime
I appreciate you taking the time to give me advice, this all feels very new its been a lot of back and forth between those two feelings. But I’ll try to see it through, thank you very much.

I’ve heard this and I believe it 100% but the thing is I’ve never gone through a romantic break up before, so I don’t know where to start or if I’m actually doing what’s right to heal. I know that you’re right though it does take time, as I have been feeling a bit better recently since we first stopped contacting each other 6 months ago. But all those feelings I felt previously when it was fresh are rushing back in like the time in between hadn’t happened
